description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by researcher location over a series of years. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays chronological years from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and utilizes a logarithmic scale (base 10) ranging from $10^0$ to $10^2$, with major tick marks placed at $10^0$, $10^1$, and $10^2$. The bars are grouped together by year, with each individual bar within a group representing a specific researcher location as defined by the legend: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). The number of categories present in each year varies; for example, 2012 and 2013 contain only a single orange bar for the USA at an approximate value of 2, while years like 2018 and 2021 contain bars for all six locations. The shortest bars in the chart align with the $10^0$ (1) line, occurring for the USA in 2014, DE in 2015, IN in 2017, and IT in 2022. The tallest bar is the blue "Other" category in 2021, which extends just above the $10^2$ mark to an approximate value of 115. The groups are sorted chronologically from left to right. Visually, the bars for the year 2022 are emphasized by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of their respective legend colors, distinguishing them from the solid colors used for the years 2012 through 2021.
